hook_text: R93 860 for 38 boxes of books? One rough answer catches the mistake.
clip_script: Estimate 38 times R247. Round 38 to 40 and 247 to 250. Forty times two hundred and fifty is ten thousand. So the cost should be close to R10 000. Because both numbers were rounded up, the true answer will be a little less than ten thousand. An estimate exposes the error instantly: if your exact answer for 38 times 247 is 1 186 or 93 860, the estimate of about ten thousand tells you something has gone wrong.
visual_style: A stack of book boxes with a price tag; numbers round on screen to 40 and 250; a wrong total flashes red next to a 10 000 target, then the correct 9 386 glows green.
mood: Detective-style, catching mistakes before they happen.
pacing: Fast rounding, pause on the estimate, quick contrast between wrong and right answers.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to master long division with a check that proves your answer.
